metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Koozies | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET koozies for your next event. Eco-friendly and fully customizable. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Recycled PET koozies are made from post-consumer plastic bottles, offering a sustainable alternative to traditional foam or neoprene. They keep drinks cold while reducing plastic waste, making them ideal for eco-conscious brands, trade shows, and company picnics. Customize with your logo using full-color screen printing or digital transfer for a crisp, vibrant look that aligns with your green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET koozies with full-color logo print, eco-friendly drink insulator
